description:
Render the run's results to the terminal per the spec. Print each requirement title green if satisfied, red if not; for a failed requirement also print its failing checks in red, including the agent's `evidence`; passing checks are omitted (only the green requirement title shows). Route output through the existing `Terminal` and honor global color settings.
